correctness.rationale: The one-step transition from agreeing hubs forces all leaves to the hub color and keeps hubs agreeing; it reaches a fixed state or the deterministic two-cycle in one update except at an initial terminal state. Opposed hubs create an independent Bin(m,1/2) new leaf count, with hub outputs equal below/above r=m/2 and opposed at the exact tie. The balanced stage survives each round with probability c_m and so its exit is geometric with 1-c_m>0, independent of the next fresh-binomial H stage; this gives the stated outcome probabilities, PGFs E[z^tau], E tau, Var tau, unbiased initial law and m->infinity limit. All boundary k=0,r,m and m=2 are covered; no odd m claimed.
